decisive_items: Singular and large heterotypic proliferative lymphoid cells
Multiple enlarged lymph nodes were noted in the neck and abdomen regions
response.rationale: Biopsy findings of proliferative atypical lymphoid cells with vascular and adipose tissue infiltration are definitive for lymphoma; widespread lymphadenopathy and extranodal lesions support systemic lymphomatous spread.

rejected.why: Sarcoidosis typically shows non-caseating granulomas, not large heterotypic proliferative lymphoid cells with vascular/adipose infiltration.
Tuberculosis would require granulomatous inflammation or caseation; the atypical lymphoid proliferation and multisystem PET findings are not characteristic.
Metastatic cancer could explain multiple lesions, but the lymph node biopsy shows a lymphoid neoplasm rather than an epithelial malignancy.
